summary: 1934 stairway lookout on the Nett Lake Indian Reservation, Koochiching County, MN; 125 ft per survey notes; standing and Band-administered; no staffing or fire records found.

events.note: Build year per the NHLR Built field; an inscription on one tower footing is dated Sept. 6, 1934. No builder named.

notes_for_editor: Build year 1934 rests on the NHLR Built field and the footing inscription. Height 38.1 m (125 ft) is added to the record from an undated survey note; the record had none. No staffing, fire or visiting-rules source was found, so access is left out; the story says to ask the Band first. A statewide A-Z lookout list (Wikimedia Commons PDF) names the Band as owner, but its row gives no date or height here, so it is not cited. No builder is named anywhere; do not attribute to the CCC without a source.
